en.headline: Hong Kong Palace Museum outdoor Art Plaza Project ends on Monday
en.dek: The free public art exhibition of six large installations inspired by traditional Chinese gardens remains open at the Museum Plaza in West Kowloon until 2 November.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum’s first outdoor public art exhibition, The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: The Art Plaza Project, will close on Monday after running since November last year.

Organised by the museum and solely sponsored by The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, the project presents six sculptures and multimedia installations by local artists and an architect. The works reinterpret traditional Chinese garden elements such as pavilions, water and rock formations using contemporary materials including bamboo, metal and fabric.

The exhibition is free of charge and open during the museum’s operating hours at the Museum Plaza in the West Kowloon Cultural District. The museum said the initiative aims to integrate art into public spaces and enhance the visitor experience.

zh.headline: 香港故宮文化博物館戶外藝術廣場計劃周一結束
zh.dek: 以傳統中國園林為靈感的六組大型裝置免費戶外展覽，將於11月2日在西九龍博物館廣場閉幕。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館首個戶外公共藝術展覽「香港賽馬會呈獻系列：香港故宮文化博物館藝術廣場計劃」將於周一結束，展覽自去年11月起舉行。
展覽由博物館主辦，並由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金獨家贊助，展出六位本地藝術家及建築師創作的六組雕塑及多媒體裝置。作品以當代物料如竹、金屬及布料重新詮釋亭台、流水及山石等傳統中國園林元素。
展覽於西九文化區博物館廣場免費開放，參觀時間與博物館開放時間相同。博物館表示，是項計劃旨在將藝術融入公共空間，提升訪客體驗。
